title: Neither Minimum nor Maximum
summary: Given an integer array with distinct positive numbers, identify and return any number that is not the smallest or largest, or return -1 if no such number exists.
statement: Given an integer array with distinct positive numbers, identify and return any number that is not the smallest or largest, or return -1 if no such number exists.
constraints: Return any element strictly between the minimum and maximum, or -1 when none exists.
hints: Any three distinct values contain one value between the other two.
Inspect only the first three values when available.
Return their sum minus their minimum and maximum.
The remaining value is neither the global minimum nor maximum because both a smaller and larger array value are present.
editorial: The remaining value is neither the global minimum nor maximum because both a smaller and larger array value are present.

tests.explanation: Both two and three are valid; this implementation deterministically returns the middle of the first three values.
Two values leave no element strictly between the extremes.
